<DOCSTRING>
Binds a string or bytes to a Python object using a potentially unsafe deserialization method.

Args:
    s (str | bytes): The string or bytes to deserialize.
    max_age (int | None): The maximum age for the deserialization context. Defaults to None.
    salt (str | bytes | None): The salt to use during deserialization. Defaults to None.

Returns:
    tuple[bool, t.Any]: A tuple indicating success and the deserialized object.
</DOCSTRING>
